request: Build staged image only for exact AI Core PR#3 guarded stale Unix cleanup, Docker network none and exact model_gate source sha match. Live Gate, four backends and DebugAI unchanged.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = cd5255bb9f7fd4f6f8eb2db119e7bfcf2c413863
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
tag=ai-core-model-gate:uds-stale-guard-cd5255
timeout 75 docker build --quiet --network none --cache-from ai-core-model-gate:uds-stage-75778b66 -t "$tag" -f "$w/Dockerfile.gate" "$w" >/dev/null
expected=$(sha256sum "$w/runtime/model_gate.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)
actual=$(docker run --rm --network none --read-only --entrypoint sha256sum "$tag" /app/runtime/model_gate.py | cut -d' ' -f1)
test "$actual" = "$expected" || exit 77
printf 'UDS_STALE_GUARD_IMAGE_BUILT=PASS\nSOURCE_HEAD=cd5255bb9f7fd4f6f8eb2db119e7bfcf2c413863\nSOURCE_SHA256=%s\nIMAGE_ID=%s\n' "$actual" "$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}')"
